vocab.description: Vocabulary 4.0: levels A1–C2, added basic words, corrections

changes: Phones: the app's own keyboard (QWERTY or QWERTZ, with the special letters) instead of the phone keyboard, with Check and Next keys
Phones, while typing: a compact card and a small round menu button, so the whole word stays in view
New page Preferences: keyboard, dictionary choice, learning rules and review intervals; Update Progress keeps only your progress
Review: a clear message when the chosen topic or level has no taught words yet, with a button to review all taught words
Two dictionaries: by frequency or by level A1 → C2, each with its own progress (Update Progress page)
Vocabulary 4.0: 291 basic words added (articles, pronouns, prepositions, everyday words); they come first in New Words and can be skipped
Levels A1–C2 from FLELex; grammatical gender for 1,405 nouns; 166 translations corrected; duplicates merged
Typing French: any of the forms is correct (le / la / les: la, les, le la…), other spellings too (diner, oeuvre)
New page About & Licence: sources of the vocabulary and the licence (non-commercial use)
